edits.old: **NUMGEN — Number Genesis** (v1.20.8, `numgen-v1.20.8`). Owns relational composition, representation and realization modules; its continuous local-history modules and its discrete DISC modules remain separately typed. Imports OFN, DYAD, GEN and TDR-G (DISC) at the editions in its §9.1; exports to RECOG by RID (N5AS1 definitions and results) and records RECOG as a consumer (its §9.1 row). Its foundational/technical profile is not evidence for OPEN-P1.
edits.new: **NUMGEN — Number Genesis** (v1.21, `numgen-v1.21`). Owns relational composition, representation and realization modules; its continuous local-history modules and its discrete DISC modules remain separately typed. Imports OFN, DYAD, GEN and TDR-G (DISC) at the editions in its §9.1; exports to RECOG by RID (N5AS1 definitions and results) and one route row to Genesis (IF38); records RECOG's explicit-domain theorems as independent agreement, not imports (its §9.1 acceptance matrix). Its foundational/technical profile is not evidence for OPEN-P1.

edits.old: **DYAD — Dyadic Oscillator** (v6.4.22, `dyad-v6.4.22`). Owns the selected primitive map, local return enclosure and normalization, ISP geometry and the explicitly defined $p$-resonance coefficient programme. Direct consumers: Genesis, Triadic, RECOG, DZT, OPEN M, continuous Number Genesis modules, RRF, OFN; AZ cross-indexes its arithmetic. Imports RECOG results (its §7: RECOG-THM-R9-MEMORY as the stated assumption of its OPEN 3/21 asymptotic-phase theorems; RECOG-THM-A1A-RECIPROCAL-AMPLITUDE), NUMGEN, RRF conventions and OFN commitments.
edits.new: **DYAD — Dyadic Oscillator** (v6.4.23, `dyad-v6.4.23`). Owns the selected primitive map, local return enclosure and normalization, ISP geometry and the explicitly defined $p$-resonance coefficient programme. Direct consumers: Genesis, Triadic, RECOG, DZT, OPEN M, continuous Number Genesis modules, RRF, OFN; AZ cross-indexes its arithmetic. Its scientific imports are RECOG results (its §7: RECOG-THM-R9-MEMORY as the stated assumption of its OPEN 3/21 asymptotic-phase theorems; RECOG-THM-A1A-RECIPROCAL-AMPLITUDE); RRF conventions are standard references (IF29), OFN commitments programme context (IF02), and Number Genesis appears as a consumer and in the L-PHASE interface (its §7.0, §7.0a).

edits.old: **TRIAD — Triadic Birth–Lift** (v1.6.1, `triad-v1.6.1`). Owns its birth/lift and diagnostic-model ledger and the T-6 export protocol. Imports Genesis (primitive seed, metric conventions), Dyadic, RRF (CN-05 planar metric convention), OFN and Programme; exports scoped diagnostics to Genesis and OPEN M.
edits.new: **TRIAD — Triadic Birth–Lift** (v1.7, `triad-v1.7`). Owns its birth/lift and diagnostic-model ledger and the T-6 export protocol. Imports Genesis (primitive seed, metric conventions) and Dyadic claim by claim; RRF (CN-05 planar metric convention), OFN, the Programme and TDR-G are reference-only pointers (its §7.1); exports scoped diagnostics to Genesis and OPEN M, with per-recipient consumer state in its §7.4.

edits.old: **GEN — Genesis Geometry** (v2.8.9, `gen-v2.8.9`). One canonical owner file combining primitive $K_3/K_4$ algebra with quaternionic metric, constrained-lift, network and Regge machinery; retains the test framework and geometry verdict custody for OPEN M. Imports Dyadic, Triadic, OFN; TDR-G input remains a blocked cross-branch interface (IF25). The proposed split of primitive algebra from the geometry framework is still a proposal (§6.7).
edits.new: **GEN — Genesis Geometry** (v2.10, `gen-v2.10`). One canonical owner file combining primitive $K_3/K_4$ algebra with quaternionic metric, constrained-lift, network and Regge machinery; retains the test framework and geometry verdict custody for OPEN M. Imports Dyadic, Triadic and one Number Genesis route row (IF38); the Programme and OFN are companion references, not scientific imports (its §7); TDR-G input remains a blocked cross-branch interface (IF25). The proposed split of primitive algebra from the geometry framework is still a proposal (§6.7).

edits.old: **RECOG — Relational Recognition** (v0.3.23, `recog-v0.3.23`). Owns comparators, return-content results, candidate event strata and the lattice-memory theorems on the dyadic substrate. Imports Dyadic, Number Genesis (by RID at v1.20.8), Genesis, OFN and RRF conventions; its results are consumed by Dyadic, OFN, RRF and RER (RECOG §7.3). The general-$p$ return-equivariance proof is RECOG's; the bridge-lemma statement RID is Dyadic's — a settled custody split, not a pending transfer. Its OPEN registry and the live-file exception of its release record are the owner's; see RECOG §2 and `records/recog/RECOG_v0_3_23_RELEASE_RECORD.md` §11.
edits.new: **RECOG — Relational Recognition** (v0.3.27, `recog-v0.3.27`). Owns comparators, return-content results, candidate event strata and the lattice-memory theorems on the dyadic substrate. Imports Dyadic and Number Genesis by RID (at `dyad-v6.4.23` and `numgen-v1.21`), Genesis, OFN and RRF conventions; its results are consumed by Dyadic, OFN, RRF and RER (RECOG §7.3). The general-$p$ return-equivariance proof is RECOG's; the bridge-lemma statement RID is Dyadic's — a settled custody split, not a pending transfer. Its OPEN registry and release record are the owner's; see RECOG §2 and `records/recog/RECOG_v0_3_27_RELEASE_RECORD.md`.

edits.old: **TDRG — Discrete Genesis** (v2.12.13, `tdrg-v2.12.13`). Owns native cyclic-state/event definitions, policy branches, kinematic/BIND3 modules and the growth/suppression programme; imports OFN and Programme (its §7 pins v0.6 and v1.1). Exports to Number Genesis (DISC) and AZ (Threads B/C). Its owner pass has not been executed since v1.2.
edits.new: **TDRG — Discrete Genesis** (v2.12.14, `tdrg-v2.12.14`). Owns native cyclic-state/event definitions, policy branches, kinematic/BIND3 modules and the growth/suppression programme; imports OFN (its §7 claim pin v0.10; historical v0.6/v0.7 pins at its §2) and cites the Programme as context (v1.3). Exports to Number Genesis (DISC) and AZ (Threads B/C). Its owner pass since v1.2 is executed in part: v2.12.14 is a corrections edition under its declared Methodology v1.2, and records the state of the four owner-review tasks of Programme v1.2 §6 in its §2; the Methodology v1.4 migration is planned for its v2.13.
